title: Great product, price point a bit high
text: I got to try this product through a promotion from Amazon prime, for less than the normal cost of the monthly box (~$17) total. It came with this deconstruct-able snowman and some treats to make the face for it, and 1 chew stick. It was very cute, but I think that the normal price point is too high. The price I paid would be reasonable I think for the contents.
label: positive
